briefing: It is red because its dust is full of rust.
Mars is cold and dry, and its sky looks pink in the day.
Two tiny moons spin around it, and long ago rivers may have run across the surface.
Now the land is empty, and you are the first pilot to place a beacon here.
preflightLine: Asteroid belt ahead. Rocks with words on them. Type the word, the blaster does the rest. Ready when you are, pilot.
beaconFlavor: Rust and rivers. Someone will come back for those.
